title: Registers ("a, "b)
instruction_text:
Store multiple clipboards!

'"a' before yank/delete = use register 'a'
'"ayy' = yank line to register a
'"ap' = paste from register a
'"byy' = yank to register b
':reg' = view all registers

Your task: Copy BOTH words using different registers,
then paste them in order.

Steps:
1. Move to 'SECOND'
2. Press '"ayiw' (yank inner word to register a)
3. Move to 'FIRST'
4. Press '"byiw' (yank inner word to register b)
5. Move to 'Result:' line (press 'j')
6. Press 'A' to append, type a space, press ESC
7. Press '"bp' (paste from register b = FIRST)
8. Press 'a' to append, type a space, press ESC
9. Press '"ap' (paste from register a = SECOND)
10. Save with :wq
